sub_questions.question: Can the finance team pay for a Team subscription by invoice or bank transfer instead of credit card?

claims.claim: Credit card is the only payment method available today on any Cloud plan.
claims.guide_evidence: Payment is by credit card by default; paying by invoice or bank transfer ... is not available on any plan today.

claims.claim: Dify is exploring a pay-by-invoice / bank transfer option.
claims.guide_evidence: paying by invoice or bank transfer is still being evaluated by Dify

claims.claim: If it ships, invoice/bank transfer is expected to apply only to annual Professional subscriptions.
claims.guide_evidence: if it ships, is expected to be limited to annual Team subscriptions only

claims.claim: Invoice/bank transfer is not available currently.
claims.guide_evidence: it is not available on any plan today

claims.claim: Checking the Billing page periodically is a way to find out if invoice payment becomes available.
Reaching out to Dify's sales team is an option if invoicing is a hard requirement now.

evaluation.rationale: The answer is right that invoice and bank-transfer payment isn't available today. But it says the planned option will be limited to annual Professional subscriptions, and the guide says annual Team subscriptions. This billing error could lead a Team customer to give up on invoicing or move to the wrong plan. The suggestions to check the Billing page and contact sales also don't come from the guide.
